text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since I watched Narita Brian's race.
I tried approaching her multiple times, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I have nothing to say.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're persistent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: I can't believe she won't even give me a conversation!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that person's back again. Talk about guts.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Aren't they the most stubborn Trainer so far?
She'll just turn them down anyway, though. Just like after that debut match—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard about it before. She ran in a Debut Match—the stage where
horsegirls are scouted—yet completely refused to entertain any offers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some even said the moment anyone brought up making a debut, she walked away.
...Could the answer to what troubles her lie there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, word reached me that Narita Brian was racing again.
I hurried over to the track, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Doryaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san's drive is on a whole other level today...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I heard Hishi Ama-san was the one who challenged her to this match!
No wonder she's so fired—wait! Hishi Ama-san's making her move!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna... take you down!!
Oryaaaaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wh-What... !?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gh............ Daaammiiit!!
Uwoooooooooooh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...!
...Damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Where do you think you're going? We're not done yet.
This one-on-one showdown I challenged you to is best two out of three.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely taking the next one!
So, one more time—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...The outcome is already settled. You know as well as I do
that no matter how many times we run, the result won't change.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have no desire to watch that spark die before my eyes anymore.
And I have even less interest... in putting it out myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
......Damn it...! I know that already...!!
I know full well I can't beat you as I am right now...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...But as if I'd give up after losing just once...!
Don't go acting like you know everything about me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: ...I know she'll come back to challenge you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You really don't know when to quit.
Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then let me make it plain. Her kind might act tough for a moment,
but their fighting spirit has already gone cold.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've seen dozens just like her.
Racing against them is a complete waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It satisfies nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (—That's right. Ever since that day,)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (...I've been parched.)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Come on, Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Okay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, all I ever saw ahead was my sister's back, refusing to let anyone pass.
I chased after her relentlessly. Because nothing was more fun than that.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Running, chasing... running further, chasing harder...
The more my heart was satisfied, the more it craved the "next" thing.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (—And then, that day came.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH——!!)

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Sis? Open your eyes.
Sis! Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm sorry, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wee-woo... wee-woo...)
